subject: AlphaHealth POC kickoff — calendar swap & access/recording logistics
messages:
From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@alphahealth.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@alphahealth.io>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AlphaHealth POC kickoff — proposed June 9 onsite?

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the quick responses during last week's demo. Our team is excited to kick off the hands-on POC.

We had penciled in Wednesday, June 9 for an onsite day at our Boston office (9:30 AM–4:30 PM ET). Primary goals: prompt review, routing validation, and a short load run on a representative workload.

Before we lock the agenda, two quick asks from our side:
- Visitor access: we need a confirmation of Redwood staff names for building passes (badging required).
- Recording: is Redwood comfortable with screen recording for internal replay? We can redact sensitive prompts if needed.

If June 9 doesn't work, we can pivot — happy to do a hybrid or fully virtual session.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Collins
Director, Platform Engineering
AlphaHealth
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@alphahealth.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlphaHealth POC kickoff — proposed June 9 onsite?

Hi Sarah — thanks, this looks great. Monica here from Redwood — happy to run the session. Quick notes:

1) Dates: June 9 works for our core engineering team (Rishi and Lauren) but our lead infra engineer has a conflict that day morning; we can make a day-long session if we switch to Thursday, June 10 or run the main walkthrough on June 9 with the infra-focused load test on June 10. Thoughts?

2) Visitor pass info: we will provide names and DOBs for badging once you confirm the final attendee list.

3) Recording: Redwood is generally okay with recordings for internal review, but we ask that (a) the recording be limited to session screens, (b) prompts flagged as sensitive are redacted or omitted, and (c) Redwood receives the recording for our audit records.

4) Logistics we want to cover in the hands-on: prompt routing across model variants, prefix/KV cache behavior on long sessions, and a 20–30 minute throughput run (we'll bring a small load harness). Can we reserve a wired table and dedicated AV output for streaming?

I've attached a draft agenda and an internal visitor-pass checklist. If June 10 is cleaner for you, we can update calendar invites.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@alphahealth.io>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlphaHealth POC kickoff — proposed June 9 onsite?

Looping in a couple of technical notes from our runtime team:

- For the throughput run, recommend we do three short ramps (10, 30, 60 RPS) to capture latency percentiles. We will need a stable ethernet line to avoid wireless jitter.
- If you prefer a hybrid setup (onsite observers + virtual guests), we can run the load harness from a Redwood laptop and stream via your meeting room. That avoids local infra changes on your network.
- Routing tests: bring two saved prompt sets (one short, one long) — we will show behavior with KV cache warm/ cold.

If June 10 is an option, it's slightly better for our infra lead and gives us time to finalize the load harness.

-Rishi
Technical Lead, Serving Runtime
From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@alphahealth.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@alphahealth.io>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlphaHealth POC kickoff — proposed June 9 onsite?

Hi all — appreciate the details. Small update on our side: several stakeholders are traveling on June 9 and the security team prefers not to process multiple external visitors on that date. Would it be possible to run the client-facing walkthrough on June 9 virtually (screen sharing + recording) and move the hands-on load validation with Redwood engineers to an onsite half-day on June 11 (afternoon)? That would reduce foot traffic and allow the infra team (who's on-site on the 11th) to be present.

Also: procurement asked if we can get a short invoice/statement of work for the dedicated day to align budgets. Tom — can you own that?

Thanks,
Sarah
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@alphahealth.io>, Tom Evans <tom.evans@alphahealth.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlphaHealth POC kickoff — proposed June 9 onsite?

Thanks Sarah — that plan works from Redwood. Updated proposal:

- Wed, June 9 — 11:00 AM–1:00 PM ET: virtual client walkthrough (screen share, record). Agenda: product overview, prompt review, quick routing demo.
- Fri, June 11 — 1:00 PM–4:30 PM ET: onsite hands-on (load validation + KV-cache warmup). Redwood will bring the load harness and a wired laptop.

Action items:
- Monica: I'll send final attendee names and the visitor pass instructions by EOD Wednesday (attached: visitor_pass_instructions.pdf).
- Tom: procurement requested a short SOW/invoice for the onsite session — would you be able to circulate that to procurement@alphahealth.io?
- Lauren/Rishi: please confirm the load harness build; we intend to run three ramps (10/30/60 RPS).

Attachment: alpha_poc_agenda_v0.3.pdf (draft); visitor_pass_instructions.pdf (forms/ID checklist).

On recording: we agree to the constraints Sarah noted. Please confirm you will share the recording with Redwood for our compliance logs.

Monica
From: Tom Evans <tom.evans@alphahealth.io>
To: Procurement <procurement@alphahealth.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@alphahealth.io>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlphaHealth POC kickoff — proposed June 9 onsite?

Hi team — procurement confirmed they can accept a short SOW. I've attached a one-page estimate and will open a DocuSign for signature next week. Monica, please expect a DocuSign link (related_links: https://docusign.com/alphahealth/AH-1024) and let me know if you need any accounting codes to appear on the invoice.

Tom
Director, IT Operations
AlphaHealth
